description: This script contains tests for Git's branch and reflog features, specifically testing the syntax for referencing previous branches using @{-n} notation. It defines several test cases to verify correct behavior when switching branches, merging, and parsing references to prior branches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks for successful execution.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or variables for equality.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the provided command fails when executed.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the repository with a specified message.
